The ex-dividend date is two business days before a company's record date in most cases, which is the date on which the company determines which shareholders are entitled to receive a dividend. The ex-dividend date is of consequence because whenever a stock is bought or sold, the trade can take two business days or more to settle. In other words, investors can purchase Tai Hing Group Holdings' shares before the 17th of September in order to be eligible for the dividend, which will be paid on the 9th of October.
